newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa industrials end weak, golds off on bullion.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa industrials end weak, golds off on bullion.

text.p: South African shares ended slightly weaker in quiet trade as the rand moved off firmer early levels. Gold shares closed weak on a softer bullion price.

Dealers said the market opened slightly firm on the rand and ticked up at noon on the back of stronger world markets. As the rand slipped off morning highs in the afternoon industrials also moved lower.
Volumes traded were high and dealers said there had been good two-way trade. Institutions were absent and futures players helped push volumes higher, they said.
The overall index ended down 3.8 points to 7,003.8 points, industrial index gained 6.3 points to 8,258.4 points and golds fell 15.1 points to 1,668.4 points.
